title: Hoi An Lantern Boat & Night Market
description: Immerse yourself in the magical glow of Hoi An's Ancient Town. As the sun sets, this historic trading port transforms into a romantic, lantern-lit wonderland.
content:
> **Executive Summary:**
>
> *   The "Hoi An Lantern Boat & Night Market" experience is a 3-hour evening activity, year-round, involving a private traditional wooden boat cruise on the Hoai River and exploration of the Night Market across the Japanese Covered Bridge. This activity is best paired with a relaxing day at the Hoiana Resort.
> *   The experience, set in Hoi An's 15th to 19th-century Ancient Town, features a moderate physical demand due to walking and includes luxury SUV transfers and priority reservations when booked through AGS. Motorized vehicles are restricted in the evening, enhancing the lantern-lit atmosphere.
>
> *Related: Explore our [Premium Southeast Asia Tours](/tours/) luxury itinerary.*

## The AGS Executive Summary
Immerse yourself in the magical glow of Hoi An's Ancient Town. As the sun sets, this historic trading port transforms into a romantic, lantern-lit wonderland.

## The Operator & Origin Story
Hoi An's preservation as a meticulously maintained 15th to 19th-century trading port is unparalleled. The town restricts motorized vehicles in the evening, retaining its atmospheric charm with its vibrant silk lanterns.

## The Itinerary & Deep Dive
As dusk falls, your private guide walks you through the Ancient Town to the Japanese Covered Bridge. Board a private, traditional wooden boat to cruise the Hoai River, releasing a paper lantern—a local tradition for good luck. 

The evening concludes with an exploration of the Night Market across the bridge.

## Experience Data
| Metric | Details |
|---|---|
| **Vibe / Atmosphere** | Romantic, Vibrant, Visual |
| **Duration** | 3 Hours (Evening) |
| **Physical Demand** | Moderate (Walking) |
| **Best Paired With** | A relaxing day at the Hoiana Resort. |

## Unwinding Along the Lantern-Lit Hoai River After Playing Hoiana Shores or Vinpearl Nam Hoi An
When the afternoon sea breeze stiffens across the links dunes of Robert Trent Jones Jr.’s [Hoiana Shores Golf Club](/courses/vietnam/hoiana-shores/) (Par 71, 7,004 yards) or the giant waste bunkers of [Vinpearl Golf Nam Hoi An](/courses/vietnam/vinpearl-nam-hoi-an/) (Par 72, 7,125 yards), finishing your round and driving just 15 to 20 minutes north across the Cua Dai Bridge brings you straight into the pedestrian-only heart of **Hoi An Ancient Town**. For guests staying at [Four Seasons Resort The Nam Hai](/accommodations/vietnam/four-seasons-nam-hai/), [Anantara Hoi An Resort](/accommodations/vietnam/anantara-hoi-an/), [Namia River Retreat](/accommodations/vietnam/namia-river-retreat-hoi-an/), or our private [An Bang Beachfront Villas](/accommodations/vietnam/an-bang-beach-villas/), the **Hoi An Lantern Boat & Night Market** evening requires minimal walking while capturing the signature romance of Central Vietnam.

## Private Sampan Charter & Riverside Dining Coordination
* **Skip-the-Pier Private Boarding:** Between 6:30 PM and 8:00 PM, public boat queues near the Japanese Covered Bridge (*Chùa Cầu*) can back up along Bach Dang Quay. Your Asia Golf Specialists local host pre-arranges a private, hand-rowed wooden sampan at a quieter riverside jetty so your couple or fourball steps straight aboard with wax-paper lotus lanterns in hand.
* **Merchant House Architecture & Night Market Stroll:** After a serene 25-minute glide across the lantern reflections of the Hoai River, step ashore on An Hoi Islet to browse hand-woven silk lanterns, lacquerware, and sizzling street snacks before taking your reserved riverside table at *Mango Mango*, *Cargo Club*, or *Morning Glory Signature*.
* **Curfew-Timed VIP Return Transfers:** Because Hoi An bans motor vehicles from the core heritage streets each evening, your chauffeur coordinates a precise perimeter drop-off and pickup just 150 meters from the riverfront, returning you to [New World Hoiana Beach Resort](/accommodations/vietnam/new-world-hoiana/) or An Bang Beach without waiting for taxis.

## Connecting the Hoai River Cruise With Bespoke Tailoring & An Bang Villa Recovery
For guests staying at [Four Seasons Resort The Nam Hai](/accommodations/vietnam/four-seasons-nam-hai/), [Namia River Retreat](/accommodations/vietnam/namia-river-retreat-hoi-an/), [Anantara Hoi An Resort](/accommodations/vietnam/anantara-hoi-an/), or our private [An Bang Beachfront Villas](/accommodations/vietnam/an-bang-beach-villas/) during [Hoi An Beachfront Bliss](/tours/hoi-an-beachfront-bliss/), we frequently pair a 4:30 PM bespoke suit fitting in the Ancient Town with this 6:00 PM private Hoai River lantern boat charter after a morning round at [Hoiana Shores Golf Club](/courses/vietnam/hoiana-shores/) or [Montgomerie Links](/courses/vietnam/montgomerie-links/).

faqs.q: How far is the Hoi An Lantern Boat experience from Hoiana Shores Golf Club and An Bang Beach?
faqs.a: Hoi An's Hoai River pier sits just 15 minutes north of Hoiana Shores Golf Club and New World Hoiana Resort, and 10 minutes from Four Seasons The Nam Hai and our private An Bang Beachfront Villas.

faqs.q: When is the Full Moon Lantern Festival in Hoi An, and do lanterns glow on other nights?
faqs.a: While the 14th day of each lunar month marks Hoi An's official Full Moon Lantern Festival (when electric streetlights are dimmed), thousands of silk lanterns and candlelit river boats illuminate the Hoai River every single evening year-round.

faqs.q: Can we combine the Hoi An Lantern Boat ride with a riverside dinner for our golf group?
faqs.a: Yes. Asia Golf Specialists sequences a 6:00 PM Old Town twilight walk and private 25-minute lantern sampan ride directly into a 7:15 PM reserved balcony table at Mango Mango or Morning Glory Signature overlooking the river.
